欢迎来到 Pictide，一起试试漫游？: Welcome to Pictide. Let's try roaming!
继续上次的漫游引导？: Pick up where we left off?
点「开始漫游」，看看第一张。: Start roaming to see your first image.
图片正在准备，稍等一下。: Your image is on its way.
图片好了，点这里关掉毛玻璃。: It's ready! Tap here to reveal it.
第一张图片来了。喜欢就点个心，也可以看下一张。: Here's your first image. Like it? Tap the heart, or try the next one.
喜欢就点个心，也可以看下一张。: Like it? Tap the heart, or try the next one.
找到喜欢的了！打开锚点，留住感兴趣的元素。: Found one you like! Open anchors to keep what caught your eye.
打开锚点，留住感兴趣的元素。: Open anchors to keep what catches your eye.
点选标签，调整想保留的元素。: Tap tags to choose what stays in your next images.
当前无法编辑锚点，可以先继续探索。: Anchors are unavailable here. Feel free to keep exploring.
再看一张，沿着这个方向继续。: Try the next image to follow this direction.
想换个方向时，点这里清空锚点。: Ready for a change? Clear your anchors here.
打开锚点，试试换个方向。: Open anchors to try a new direction.
清空好了，看看新的画面吧。: All clear. Let's see something new!
刚才喜欢的图片，也都留着呢。点「喜欢」，回去看看。: Your favorites are saved. Open Liked to revisit them.
点「喜欢」，看看收藏图片的地方。: Open Liked to see where your favorites will live.
这里也有毛玻璃，点一下就能看。: Your favorites have privacy blur too. Tap to reveal them.
喜欢的画面，随时都能回来重看。: Come back to your favorites anytime.
点过喜欢的图片，会收在这里。: The images you like will be saved here.
接下来，按你的心意漫游吧。: Now, let your curiosity lead the way.
回到当前步骤，继续一起探索。: Return to this step to keep exploring together.
